title.narrative: Activity under preparation MAAP 2025-2026 AD 3 Structural Support in Conflict Prevention & Peacebuilding

description.narrative: In light of increasing violent conflict globally, due to geopolitical tensions, technological advancements in warfare, and the internationalisation of conflicts, this action aims at reinforcing the EU¿s role in early warning, conflict prevention and peacebuilding. The action will contribute to strengthening the EU's role as a global peace actor by focusing EU's conflict prevention efforts on the following three priorities: (a) strengthening early warning and conflict mapping, (b) supporting international accountability mechanisms, and (c) deepening meaningful dialogue with civil society organisations (CSOs) on conflict prevention and peacebuilding. Early warning systems and conflict mapping contribute to preventing violence by enabling timely and informed interventions, while supporting international accountability mechanisms ensures justice for victims and deters future atrocities crimes. Meaningful exchanges with CSOs enhance the EU's understanding of local contexts, informing early action and improving conflict prevention strategies. These combined and bolstered prevention efforts aim at fostering a more stable, just, and peaceful international order.
